== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[I'm Sorry (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]] (<code>2220_2036</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 36), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The deploy is written out as the post writes it.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p841760 by darkjediknight11, 9 October 2013: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p841760
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent's turn. During your deploy phase, may deploy a Floating Refinery, a cloud sector (to Bespin), or an Obsidian squadron TIE on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if you control 2 cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-36-I_m_Sorry-PC-E2-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
